title: Ubuntu Engineering Lead
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring engineering leaders to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation - leaders who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, and have a proven track record for building, nurturing and developing high performing engineering teams.

This leadership track includes roles for managers and Senior+ engineers alike. At Canonical, managers are expected to stay technical and close to the code, and our Senior+ engineers lead and develop software projects, as well as the processes and people around them.

Our teams integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world's most deployed open source operating system, it's a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

Four key teams that ship Ubuntu are the

  • Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
  • Server : leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
  • Desktop : driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter
  • Debcrafters : a new team responsible for the forward movement, maintenance and overall health of the Ubuntu archive: one of the most abundant repositories of open source software available today

You'll be accountable for your technical roadmap, and responsible for your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies.

Location

We have remote roles open in every time zone.

Role entails

  • Leading their teams in elevating the Linux developer and user experience
  • Designing, building and shipping high quality, performant software in Rust, Go and Python
  • Demonstrating sound engineering principles through architecture, development and code reviews
  • Taking responsibility for planning, estimation and execution
  • Working with product management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu
  • Setting expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Offering coaching, mentoring, technical feedback and hands‑on career development
  • Contributing to upstream and neighboring open source projects
  • Optimizing the distribution for performance, reliability, and security
  • Debugging complex system‑level issues and delivering robust solutions
  • Authoring and improving technical and community documentation

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Ability to drive and deliver technical work streams going above and beyond expectations
  • Lead and coach others to deliver exceptional engineering work
  • A demonstrated passion for open source software
  • Significant experience with Rust, Go, Python, Flutter or C/C++
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Experience contributing to or leading open source projects
  • Experience with Linux distributions/distribution engineering
  • Experience with software packaging and distribution mechanisms
  • Performance or Security Engineering experience

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The Project Management Support Officer provides operational, analytical and administrative support to ensure effective planning, implementation and monitoring of projects in line with UNOPS policies and client/partner requirements. title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

The Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for protecting the organization's information systems and digital assets by developing, implementing, and maintaining technical security controls. This role includes conducting security assessments, monitoring systems for vulnerabilities or intrusions, and ensuring that the organization’s IT environment remains compliant with industry and regulatory standards such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and GDPR. The engineer also plays a critical role in incident detection, response, and prevention.

Supervisory Authority

NONE

Nature And Scope

Operating in a dynamic threat landscape, the Cybersecurity Engineer reports to the Senior Director of Cybersecurity and works with other IT, compliance, and business stakeholders. Although not a supervisory role, the Cybersecurity Engineer may guide junior staff or external contractors and lead technical implementation efforts on security-related projects. The role demands staying up to date on emerging threats, tools, and best practices, and proactively evolving the organization's defenses accordingly.

This position is both hands‑on and strategic, requiring expertise in secure system design, threat intelligence, monitoring tools, and risk mitigation. It encompasses environments spanning on‑premises data centers, hybrid infrastructures, and public clouds (e.g., Azure, AWS).

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and security configuration reviews.
  • Evaluate system and application hardening measures using CIS benchmarks and STIGs.
  • Monitor networks and endpoints using tools like SIEM, EDR, and IDS/IPS (e.g., CrowdStrike, Sentinel).
  • Analyze security events and logs to detect, triage, and respond to threats.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain security tools, including:
    • Firewalls
    • Network Access Control (NAC)
    • Antivirus/Endpoint Protection
    • DLP, CASB, and vulnerability management platforms
  • Develop and enforce cybersecurity policies, standards, and operating procedures.
  • Ensure system compliance with internal policies and external frameworks such as NIST 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and PCI DSS.
  • Develop and deliver training on phishing, password hygiene, and secure computing practices.
  • Support tabletop exercises and simulation drills to test security readiness.
  • Work with DevOps and infrastructure teams to embed security into system architecture.
  • Participate in project reviews to identify and mitigate risks early in the system development lifecycle.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in the following:
    • Windows Server Operating Systems, VMware
    • Core enterprise roles such as Active Directory, Group Policy, RADIUS, PS, CAs
    • Bare metal servers and data center configurations
    • Falcon Crowdstrike
    • Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Office 365, Entra ID, Azure Sentinel
    • Hybrid cloud integrations
    • Authentication protocols
    • Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting
  • Proficient in securing firewalls, VPNs, and virtual environments (VMware/Hyper‑V).
  • Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Defender Suite, Cisco DNA, and Cisco ISE.
  • Familiar with scripting for automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to streamline security operations.
  • Deep knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps principles, and CI/CD pipeline security.
  • Experience implementing TLS, SSL, VPN encryption, HSMs, and certificate lifecycle management.
  • Deep understanding of encryption, PKI, authentication, secure networking, and operating system security across Linux and Windows environments.
  • Proficient in analyzing logs, threat intelligence, and indicators of compromise (IOCs) to drive timely threat mitigation.
  • Ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Methodical and responsive approach to detecting, responding to, and remediating security incidents.
  • Works cross‑functionally with IT, audit, compliance, and legal to promote enterprise‑wide security awareness and enforcement.
  • Careful review of systems, code, and configurations to identify small changes that may indicate large risks.
  • Able to shift priorities rapidly in response to new vulnerabilities, threat campaigns, or business requirements.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor's degree from a four‑year college or university in computer science/Information Technology with a security concentration. A master’s degree in business administration is highly desirable. Must have 7–10 years of progressive experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a security engineering role. One or more industry‑recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Azure Security Engineer Associate is required or strongly preferred. The candidate should demonstrate hands‑on expertise in network and application security architecture, cloud security controls across platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP, identity and access management (including IAM, SSO, and MFA), and security monitoring tools such as SIEM, SOAR, and EDR. Experience with Zero Trust architecture and secure DevSecOps practices is essential. A solid understanding of key regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements—including GDPR, HIPAA, FERPA, and FISMA—is also required. In addition to technical capabilities, the candidate should possess strong collaboration and critical thinking skills, a sharp attention to detail, and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$130,000 – $140,000

title: Assistente de Departamento Pessoal
description:
REGULAMENTO DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

O CENTRO DE ESTUDOS E PESQUISAS CIÊNTIFICAS FRANCISCO ANTÔNIO DE SALLES – FAS, através do presente regulamento torna pública a abertura das inscrições e estabelece normas relativas à realização do Processo Seletivo para a vaga descrita abaixo, a ser contratada sob o Regime CLT por contrato de experiência. O presente processo seletivo não se trata de Concurso Público, não decorrendo, portanto, qualquer estabilidade diferente das que permitidas e exigidas pela CLT para contratos de experiência.

Os dados pessoais que serão aqui coletados têm o intuito de cadastrar os interessados no Processo Seletivo para o cargo de Interesse. Ressaltamos que o acesso a essas informações e sua utilização é restrita aos responsáveis do Recursos Humanos.

DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

  • 1.1 O Processo Seletivo é regido pelas disposições contidas neste regulamento e seus anexos, possíveis adendos ou retificações e demais publicações pertinentes que serão disponibilizadas no site do FAS:
  • 1.2 O presente Processo Seletivo será realizado sob a responsabilidade do Recursos Humanos e Comissão de Processo Seletivo, designada pelo FAS, de acordo com as normas estabelecidas neste Edital.
  • 1.3 Não será permitida mais de uma inscrição por candidato, caso ocorram, a segunda inscrição será desconsiderada.
  • 1.4 É DE RESPONSABILIDADE EXCLUSIVA DO CANDIDATO, ACOMPANHAR todas as etapas do Cronograma e as publicações que poderão ser disponibilizadas NA PÁGINA DO PROCESSO SELETIVO no endereço eletrônico e ou através de contato telefônico / e-mail (não serão aceitos outlook, live, Hotmail). *O candidato que perder a data da próxima convocação não terá direito a pedido de recurso*.
  • 1.5 O Processo Seletivo terá validade de 3 meses a partir da data de contratação do candidato selecionado, podendo, mediante necessidade do FAS.
  • 1.6 O cargo, o número de vagas, a carga horária semanal, o vencimento mensal e os pré-requisitos exigidos para contratação serão informados na entrevista.
  • 1.7.6 o Processo Seletivo Será Composto De
    1. 1ª ETAPA - Inscrição, de caráter eliminatório;
    2. 2ª ETAPA - Análise dos documentos exigidos para cada cargo, de caráter eliminatório;
    3. 3ª ETAPA - Avaliação de Competências e Habilidades Comportamentais, de caráter eliminatório e classificatório. Para esta etapa, serão convocados os candidatos classificados na Etapa de Análise documental considerando o mínimo de 03 (três) candidatos por vaga e/ou para formação de cadastro reserva;
    4. 4ª ETAPA - Entrega de Documentos e Exame médico, de caráter eliminatório.
  • Somente possuirá direito a contratação o candidato que, após participar de todas as etapas previstas, for aprovado e classificado.

DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO

  • Atuará como ponto focal de Departamento Pessoal da unidade, sendo responsável pelo atendimento ao colaborador para sanar dúvidas dos mesmos;
  • Vivência em apuração de ponto biométrico.
  • Saber explicar o demonstrativo de pagamento;
  • Contato com as lideranças da unidade a fim de orientar e aplicar as orientações da equipe;
  • Filtrar as demandas oriundas do departamento pessoal otimizando o tempo e deslocamento do colaborador;
  • Realizar apontamentos de folha de folha de pagamento, atividades inerentes ao processamento de folha de pagamento.

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino Superior cursando;

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale alimentação no local;

title: Enfermeira Assistencial - Botafogo
description:
Somos um Grupo formado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Nossa identidade foi construída equilibrando o foco em pessoas com uma gestão eficiente, por isso, valorizamos profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que tenham calor humano, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos.

Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência a pacientes com doenças musculoesquelético e de terapia assistida.

Estamos em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da nossa história, mas para trabalhar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores: FOCO NAS PESSOAS.

Nossos valores

  • Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com os pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências.
  • Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.
  • Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.
  • Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo! Venha fazer história com a gente! #SomosVitus #PorUmaVidaSemDor.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais Atividades

  • Realizar assistência de enfermagem integral aos pacientes, incluindo preparo e administração de medicamentos por via subcutânea, intramuscular e endovenosa, conforme protocolos institucionais e boas práticas de segurança do paciente.
  • Executar atividades administrativas relacionadas ao atendimento e à rotina do setor, assegurando o correto registro, organização e fluxo das informações.
  • Checar a receita e a dose prescrita antes do início do atendimento ao paciente.
  • Realizar e registrar a SAE de acordo com os protocolos institucionais e necessidades do paciente.
  • Utilizar e fazer bom uso dos recursos institucionais (equipamentos, materiais, instalações e EPI's), comunicando problemas ou alterações ao superior imediato.
  • Prevenir, identificar, avaliar e intervir nos incidentes relacionados aos medicamentos e a outros problemas da assistência ao paciente.
  • Orientar e auxiliar pacientes e cuidadores quanto à assistência prestada.
  • Participar sempre que solicitado em reuniões, comissões e núcleos institucionais.
  • Desenvolver, em colaboração com os demais membros da equipe multidisciplinar, ações para a promoção, proteção e recuperação da saúde e da qualidade de vida.
  • Auxiliar na cobertura de escalas de férias, folgas e/ou intercorrências do enfermeiro assistencial na unidade quando necessário.
  • Realizar atendimento domiciliar, para aplicação de medicamentos subcutâneos e intramusculares, quando necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Graduação em Enfermagem com registro profissional ativo.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Pós-graduação em Oncologia.
  • Experiência prévia em Terapia Assistida.

  • Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias.

title: Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Coun...
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in‑house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and the Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers’ compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment‑related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in‑house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in‑house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy. The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment‑related and labor‑related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in‑house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in‑house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters. Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership. The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective‑bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi‑legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed. Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers. Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions. Responds to University officials’ request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility. Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University. Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems. Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action. Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures. Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies. Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics. Ability to participate effectively in fact‑finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations. Ability to articulate the University’s position, listen and negotiate effectively. Superior verbal and written communication skills. Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision. Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines. Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction. Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, union representatives and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and six years of post J.D. legal experience which includes at least four years of substantial employment experience, with additional knowledge of the labor process. A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and eight years of substantial labor and employment experience. All candidates must have a strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar is required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Salary Range

The anticipated salary for the Associate General Counsel position is $172,800.

The anticipated salary for the Senior Associate General Counsel position is $207,800.

Diferencial

Além disso, poderá fazer parte de um Clube de Benefícios bem diferenciado.

  • E os papais também terão esse privilégio de acompanhar bem de perto seu bebê nos primeiros dias de vida com a licença estendida no Benefício Paternidade , de até 20 dias

  • Para o deslocamento para o escritório, oferecemos Vale-Transporte.

description:
Lavras - MG

Elegível para PCD

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

As equipes de transporte da Amazon trabalham para garantir a entrega de pacotes para clientes em todo o mundo. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Líder de Time para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil em para a nossa Delivery Station no Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Como líder de equipe, você supervisionará uma de nossas estações de entrega, fornecendo liderança aos associados e gerenciando o desempenho dos principais indicadores – Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Você assumirá muitas funções e trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. A função envolve:

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança em sua área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  • Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com as diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
  • Fornecimento contínuo de informações críticas relacionadas ao turno aos operadores.
  • Envolver-se com funções de suporte e/ou outros departamentos para abordar problemas ou necessidades comuns de indicadores de desempenho, por exemplo, processos de readiness, 5S, segurança, treinamento.
  • Monitoramento do andamento das rotas, atuando de forma proativa para identificar e corrigir desvios e adequar, com foco na superação da expectativa do cliente e no gerenciamento dos custos de operação.
  • Condução de reuniões, atribuição de funções e trabalho com KPIs como despacho pontual, sucesso na entrega no primeiro dia (On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success) e aprimoramento do atendimento ao cliente.
  • Ficar obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para impulsionar as melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento / implementação de sistemas / processos mais novos e coletar feedback.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir as operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar as métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Who Are We?

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just three years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co‑founders to over 120 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest‑growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.

Our Impact

While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4,000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long‑term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.

Check us out here: Decentralized Masters

What will you be doing?

The Sales Operations Specialist is responsible for ensuring the sales organization operates with speed, accuracy, visibility, and accountability. This role owns the day‑to‑day execution and optimization of the sales tech stack—primarily "HubSpot"—so that Membership Directors (MDs), Setters, and Sales Leadership can focus on selling, not admin. This is a hands‑on, systems‑focused role, not a people manager. You will work closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data to maintain clean pipelines, automate workflows, enforce process discipline, and deliver reliable reporting. At Decentralized Masters, Sales Ops is mission‑critical. This role directly impacts close rates, cash collection, forecasting accuracy, and the overall scalability of the revenue engine.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Ownership & Sales Systems

  • Own accuracy of HubSpot CRM configuration: pipelines, deal stages, properties, workflows, and permissions
  • Ensure every lead, deal, and contact has correct lead status, lifecycle stages, ownership, and next steps
  • Maintain strict data hygiene standards (identifying/merging duplicates, no stale deals, missing properties, or broken workflows)
  • Enforce CRM usage standards across Setters and MDs

Sales Automation & Workflow Management

  • Build and maintain automation for:
    • Lead routing and assignment
    • Task creation and follow‑ups
    • Deal stage progression
    • Call outcomes and disposition tracking
  • Reduce manual admin work for sales reps wherever possible
  • QA all automations to ensure reliability and compliance

Pipeline, Forecasting & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate, real‑time visibility into:
    • Pipeline value and velocity
    • Close rates and conversion metrics
    • DPL (Deals Per Lead), APS, and other core KPIs
  • Build and maintain sales dashboards for leadership
  • Support forecasting and revenue reporting in collaboration with Finance and Data teams

Sales Tools & Integration

  • Manage and support integrations between HubSpot and:
    • Dialers (e.g., "Aloware")
    • Calendars and scheduling tools
    • Payment platforms (e.g., "Whop")
    • Analytics and BI tools
  • Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate fixes with internal tech or third‑party vendors

Process Enforcement & Enablement

  • Translate sales process changes into CRM logic and automation
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to ensure systems reinforce desired behaviors
  • Create and maintain SOPs for sales roles, systems and workflows
  • Act as the point person for Sales Ops requests, improvements, and bug fixes
  • Support and respond to Sales Ops requests submitted via Slack channels

Compliance & Data Integrity

  • Ensure CRM processes align with internal compliance standards (FTC/SEC‑aware language, DISCLAIMERS, documentation)
  • Maintain audit‑ready records for sales activity and deal history
  • Partner with Security/IT on access control and data governance

Requirements

What do you bring?

Required Experience

  • 2-5+ years in Sales Operations, RevOps, or CRM Administration
  • Hands‑on experience with "HubSpot" or similar CRM (required)
  • Mid‑Senior level Sales Operations experience
  • Strong background in sales automation and workflow design
  • Experience supporting high‑ticket or complex sales cycles preferred

Skills & Attributes

  • Highly systems‑oriented and detail‑driven
  • Strong understanding of sales metrics and funnels
  • Comfortable working cross‑functionally with Sales, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Data
  • Proactive problem‑solver who spots issues before they become revenue problems
  • Clear communicator who can translate business needs into system logic

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in high‑growth, remote‑first environments
  • Familiarity with "Whop", "Aloware", or BI tools
  • Exposure to compliance‑heavy industries (finance, education, crypto, etc.)

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote‑first culture with a globally distributed team
  • Opportunity to own the organic growth engine of a fast‑scaling DeFi brand
  • Access to cutting‑edge tools, data, and creative freedom to innovate
  • A values‑driven company culture that rewards results, autonomy, and excellence

If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you!

Throughout the programme, graduates gain practical experience and exposure to the full trade lifecycle, working at the core of our operations. By building expertise across these critical functions, graduates develop a strong foundation for success in high-impact middle office roles in Deals Desk, Operations and Trade Finance and are well‑positioned to grow into future leadership positions.

Guided by some of the most experienced professionals in the industry, graduates receive ongoing support and development opportunities, providing them with the skills, mindset and confidence to help shape the next chapter of our business.

Deals Desk

Deals Desk is responsible for accurate mark‑to‑market valuation, daily P&L and risk and exposure reporting. Deals Desk is an independent control function that works closely with commercial, middle and back‑office teams to ensure timely trade capture and effective management of trading positions in our trading and risk management systems.

Responsibilities include
  • Reviewing and verifying trades and trade terms
  • Producing daily P&L and exposure reports
  • Liaising with traders, operations and finance to reconcile positions
  • Investigating and resolving trade discrepancies

Operations

Operations coordinates the physical movement and delivery of commodities, ensuring contracts are executed efficiently and profitably.

Responsibilities include
  • Managing vessel or land logistics and documentation
  • Liaising with counter parties and terminal
  • Tracking cargo movements and inventories
  • Ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements

Trade Finance

Trade Finance designs and implements the financing solutions that enable the physical movement of commodities, while managing credit and performance risks.

Responsibilities include
  • Structuring and executing real‑world commodity trade finance deals
  • Drafting, negotiating and managing trade documents such as letters of credit, guarantees and receivables financing
  • Monitoring global trade flows, payment schedules and risk exposure across complex transactions
  • Collaborating with traders, operations, credit teams and banking partners to resolve day‑to‑day financing and logistics challenges

Knowledge Skills And Abilities

  • 0-2 years of postgraduate working experience
  • Fluency in English and Spanish - both oral and written
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • High degree of intellectual curiosity, passion, motivation and grit
  • Ability to remove roadblocks and break down barriers to get the job done
  • Passion for working in a collaborative, challenging and dynamic environment
  • A global, innovative mindset

Applications will close on 31st May 2026.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Safety Advisor to join the Saudi Aramco Loss Prevention organization (LP).

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary role is to provide daily support to company facilities and departments, helping them effectively implement the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System expectations and associated programs, as well as assuring compliance to all company safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Facilitate implementation of the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System, as well as its objectives and expectations, including developing associated safety processes, and participating in self-assessments.
  • Conduct field inspections/reviews to assess compliance to company and international codes and standards, identify safety concerns, formulate solutions, and develop practical and cost-effective corrective actions.
  • Identify, evaluate, recommend actions, and follow up on critical, yet universal safety tasks and control methodologies related to operational safety practices (e.g., work at height, isolation/LOTO, permit to work, hydrogen sulfide, confined space entry, excavations).
  • Participate in safety studies/activities using risk assessment and mitigation methodologies, such as: PHAs, HAZOPs, JSAs, incident investigations, compliance reviews, or insurance surveys.
  • Respond to emergency situations and incidents, either during or after regular working hours, to provide technical assistance and advice.
  • Participate in worksite contractor safety management activities (e.g., contractor selection and prequalification, monitoring of work site compliance, and measurement of performance).
  • Support the reporting, classification and investigation all incidents, and participating in incident investigations, determination of root causes, and proper recommendations to prevent recurrence.
  • Deliver Loss Prevention-specific training to employees, contractors, and outside parties.
  • Mentor other LP personnel.
  • You will hold a Bachelor of Science degree from an Accredited Institution and seven years of experience areas in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, such as: operations and maintenance, plant engineering, construction, turnaround and inspection, safety program development, process safety, and audits/assessments.
  • Or you will have 15 years of relevant industry experience in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, including a strong track record in delivering results, as referenced above, without a degree.
  • You will also have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Qualificações

Oportunidades para SP/ RJ/ BH.

Sua jornada na A&M

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. Nosso robusto processo de desenvolvimento de desempenho promove o aprendizado contínuo, recompensa suas contribuições e cultiva uma cultura de meritocracia. Com treinamentos de alta qualidade e oportunidades de aprendizado prático, você pode adquirir novas habilidades e avançar em sua carreira.

Priorizamos o seu bem-estar, oferecendo benefícios e recursos para apoiar sua jornada pessoal. Nossos colaboradores destacam constantemente as oportunidades de crescimento, nossa cultura empreendedora única e a diversão que vivenciamos juntos como os aspectos favoritos de trabalhar na A&M. As possibilidades são infinitas para profissionais de alto desempenho e paixão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Diversidade Inclusiva significa que abraçamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão, incentivando todos a trazerem seu \eu\ completo para o trabalho a cada dia. Isso permeia a maneira como recrutamos, desenvolvemos os colaboradores, conduzimos os negócios, apoiamos os clientes e fazemos parcerias com fornecedores. É a forma A&M de ser.

Empregador de Oportunidades Iguais

É prática da Alvarez & Marsal fornecer e promover oportunidades iguais em emprego, compensação e outras condições de trabalho, sem discriminação por raça, cor, credo, religião, origem nacional, ascendência, status de cidadania, sexo ou gênero, identidade de gênero ou expressão de gênero (incluindo status de pessoa transgênero), orientação sexual, estado civil, serviço militar e status de veterano, deficiência física ou mental, histórico médico familiar, informações genéticas ou qualquer outra condição médica protegida, afiliação política ou qualquer outra característica protegida por e em conformidade com as leis aplicáveis. Currículos Não Solicitados de Recrutadores de Terceiros

Informamos que, conforme a política da A&M, não aceitamos currículos não solicitados de recrutadores de terceiros, a menos que esses recrutadores sejam contratados para fornecer candidatos para uma vaga específica e em alinhamento com nossos valores de Diversidade Inclusiva. Inclusive Diversity

A&M’s entrepreneurial culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who can positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M’s core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are the main reasons our people love working at A&M. Inclusive Diversity means we embrace diversity, and we foster inclusiveness, encouraging everyone to bring their whole self to work each day. It runs through how we recruit, develop employees, conduct business, support clients, and partner with vendors. It is the A&M way.

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is Alvarez & Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atração & Seleção: Entender as demandas das áreas clientes, apoiando gestores na definição de cargos, perfis e requisitos das vagas; acompanhar processos de recrutamento e seleção, garantindo alinhamento com as necessidades do negócio e SLAs acordados.
  • Treinamento & Desenvolvimento: Acompanhar e apoiar a execução de treinamentos obrigatórios e ações de desenvolvimento nas áreas clientes; apoiar gestores e colaboradores na definição de planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDIs), utilizando sistemas de gestão e ferramentas de RH; acompanhar a implementação de programas e ações de desenvolvimento, garantindo alinhamento às prioridades do negócio e eficiência operacional.
  • Performance, Carreira e Sucessão: Executar e suportar os ciclos de avaliação de desempenho, por meio de reuniões com gestores e colaboradores, fóruns de equalização e reconhecimento, assegurando direcionamento claro para evolução e meritocracia; apoiar movimentações internas e decisões de carreira; participar do mapeamento de posições críticas e sucessores, por meio de reuniões e atualizações em sistemas, garantindo continuidade dos negócios e desenvolvimento de talentos; fornecer suporte consultivo aos gestores, fortalecendo seu papel como protagonistas na gestão de pessoas.
  • Cultura, Engajamento e Clima Organizacional: Atuar como guardião da cultura organizacional, apoiando a construção e disseminação de rotinas e práticas alinhadas aos valores da empresa; conduzir e apoiar pesquisas de clima e engajamento, desde a comunicação e sensibilização até a análise dos resultados e desdobramento de planos de ação junto às lideranças; levantar oportunidades de melhoria nos canais de atendimento aos colaboradores, com base em interações e feedbacks, propondo ajustes que aprimorem a comunicação, a experiência do colaborador e o engajamento das equipes; garantir a atualização dos dados de colaboradores nos sistemas de RH.
  • Orçamento de Pessoas e Governança: Acompanhar a elaboração, controle e revisões do orçamento anual de pessoas das áreas clientes, incluindo headcount, movimentações salariais, meritocracia e provisões, por meio de análises, relatórios e alinhamentos com lideranças e áreas parceiras, assegurando aderência às diretrizes financeiras, políticas internas e estratégias do negócio.
  • Desligamento: Apoiar gestores nos processos de desligamento, garantindo alinhamento com políticas e boas práticas de RH; conduzir entrevistas de desligamento, analisando dados e gerando insights para identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e definição de planos de ação quando necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento intermediário em sistemas de RH (como SuccessFactors), Excel avançado e ferramentas básicas de análise de dados.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Here Is What We Offer

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Sr. Director of IT for Auxiliary Enterprises, the IT Support Specialist is responsible for providing general IT support across all Auxiliary Enterprises. IT-related tasks may include setting up, managing, and troubleshooting technology systems used by each business unit associated with the Office of Auxiliary Enterprises. Duties may include providing end-user support with laptop and desktop computers; providing support for card readers, printers or other IT and computer peripherals; assistance with Howard University physical and Wi-Fi network; diagnosing and resolving hardware problems including specialized hardware such as point-of-sale terminals, building controllers, laundry machine interface devices, OR parking ticket issuing hand-held terminals; configuring and updating system and application software; and tracking down data and communication issues.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provides technical support for various hardware used across Auxiliary Enterprises including point-of-sale terminals, printers, laptops, desktop computers, cameras, card readers, scanners, contactless readers, monitors, kitchen-display systems, time clocks, building/laundry controllers, building/laundry readers, point-of-sale terminals, peripherals, and other equipment used by contractors and employees in Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Provide Tier-1 support for Dining Service point-of-sale terminals and peripherals.
  • Level Review diagnostics and assess the functionality and efficiency of systems.
  • Work with system providers in the support of various applications.
  • Work with Howard University ETS to implement, enforce and support security measures.
  • Monitor security certificates and company compliance with requirements.
  • Monitor systems to ensure they are operating as expected.
  • Provide technical support to Auxiliary Enterprises contract staff and troubleshoot computer systems and peripheral equipment used by Auxiliary Enterprises contractors.
  • Install and update company software and hardware as needed.
  • Anticipate and make recommendations regarding the replacement or updating of computer items.
  • Assist with installation, upgrades, and the disposal of IT-related products.
  • Coordinate with ETS and off-prem/cloud-based vendors to ensure that Auxiliary Enterprises systems and data are backed up and backups are verified and able to be restored when necessary.
  • Assemble, install, and configure systems and components per vendor specifications BUT within the policies, procedures, and best practices of Howard University, HU Enterprise Technology Services, and Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Stay updated regarding the knowledge and skills needed to keep up with rapid advancements in computer technology.
  • Maintains logs of activities and completed work and provides reports to the Sr. Director. Specifically, Laundry System Status and the Auxiliary Enterprises IT Asset List. Additional logs may be assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of TCP/IP, networking, and related technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft Windows Operating system.
  • Ability to develop plans for resolving and implementing technical and operational problems.
  • Ability to work independently, to plan and prioritize activities that may span several locations on campus.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical problems due to complex system interfaces.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to operate in an office environment and in the field (various locations across all campuses of Howard University).
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the community.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or closely related field and one year relevant experience; or equivalent combination of a total of five (5) years combined relevant education and experience.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Lead Payroll Analyst
description:
Overview

Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! The benefits information above is provided for guidance.

Job Purpose

Job Purpose

The Lead Payroll Analyst plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and effective operation of Howard University’s payroll processes. This position supports the review and validation of payroll data, monitors payroll activity for consistency, and assists in the timely processing of bi-weekly and off-cycle compensation for faculty, staff, and student workers. The Lead Payroll Analyst also serves as a primary resource for employee payroll inquiries, offering guidance and facilitating timely resolution with a strong customer service focus. The role helps maintain internal controls and supports cross-departmental collaboration to ensure payroll is administered in alignment with University policies, collective bargaining agreements, and applicable federal and state regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Nature And Scope

The Lead Payroll Analyst functions as an experienced payroll professional within the University’s centralized payroll structure and supports the accurate and timely execution of bi-weekly payrolls and supplemental off-cycle payments. The role requires close coordination with Human Resources, Budget, Benefits, Accounting, and departmental administrators to verify payroll data, ensure proper documentation, and support consistent payroll operations across the institution. This position interacts frequently with employees, supervisors, and campus partners to address payroll questions and provide guidance on payroll-related matters. The Lead Payroll Analyst must apply strong analytical skills, confidentiality, and sound judgment when evaluating payroll information or resolving issues. The role contributes to audit preparedness, supports payroll reconciliations, and assists with recurring quarterly and annual payroll reporting activities.

Principal Accountabilities

Principal Accountabilities

Payroll Preparation & Support

  • Prepare and validate payroll inputs in advance of each payroll cycle, ensuring HR-provided files (salaries, benefits, job changes) are complete and properly formatted for processing.
  • Perform pre-payroll audits to identify missing data, unexpected variances, incorrect deductions, or tax issues, and escalate findings to the Payroll Manager.
  • Support the Director/Manager during monthly payroll processing by running calculations, reviewing results, and resolving flagged errors.
  • Process routine off-cycle items such as corrections, small retro payments, and adjustments as directed by the Payroll Manager.

Employee Support & Inquiry Management

  • Manage the Payroll Inbox by monitoring, prioritizing, and responding to employee payroll questions related to pay, taxes, deductions, direct deposit, and time reporting.
  • Research and resolve routine issues; escalate complex or policy-impacting matters to the Payroll Manager.
  • Track common inquiry themes and recommend updates to FAQs or procedure guides.

Garnishments, Deductions & Payments

  • Process wage garnishments, tax levies, child support orders, and other wage attachments; maintain records and prepare remittance packets for manager approval.
  • Administer union dues, voluntary deductions, and retirement contributions that originate within Payroll’s purview (not HR-managed benefits).
  • Maintain logs of all remittances and assist in preparing reconciliations for manager review.

System Support (Workday & ADP)

  • Update and maintain basic Workday Payroll configuration items (simple deductions, tax updates, pay schedule updates) under guidance from the Payroll Manager.
  • Execute routine tests during Workday releases and patches; document issues and assist with troubleshooting.
  • Assist with ADP Tax Services interactions, including reviewing tax files, setting up new jurisdictions, and documenting tax notices for management action.

Reconciliation, Reporting & Compliance Support

  • Prepare standard payroll reports (registers, deduction reports, tax summaries) for manager review before final processing.
  • Assist with monthly reconciliations of payroll liabilities, verifying balances and following up on discrepancies with Accounting.
  • Support quarterly and year-end processes by gathering data, running preliminary reports, and assisting with W-2 review.
  • Maintain organized documentation for internal and external audit requests.

Process Improvement & Team Support

  • Document payroll procedures, update job aids, and maintain checklists to ensure consistency and accuracy in recurring tasks.
  • Recommend process improvements to reduce errors or improve efficiency.
  • Provide cross-training support to payroll staff and serve as backup on routine tasks when needed.

Core Competencies

Core Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of payroll regulations, wage attachments, and taxation, with experience supporting complex higher-education payroll environments.
  • Proficiency in Workday Payroll and familiarity with ADP SmartCompliance, including basic configuration, troubleshooting, and report execution.
  • Advanced attention to detail and analytical skills, with the ability to audit data, identify discrepancies, and support reconciliations.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain payroll concepts clearly and provide high-quality customer service.
  • Strong Excel capability (pivot tables, lookups, data validation) for payroll auditing and analysis.
  • Proven ability to maintain confidentiality, follow internal controls, and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Collaborative team player who works well with HR, Accounting, Benefits, and campus departments to resolve issues and support payroll operations.
  • Adaptable and proactive, with a continuous improvement mindset and willingness to learn new systems and processes.

Minimum Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
  • 3–5 years of payroll experience in a complex, multi-department organization; higher education experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of payroll regulations, multi-state taxation, wage garnishments, and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Experience using Workday Payroll or another enterprise-level payroll system; familiarity with ADP SmartCompliance is a plus.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to identify discrepancies and support reconciliations.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information in accordance with university policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills for responding to employee inquiries and supporting campus partners.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$105,00-$115,000

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A idéia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A idéia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

About the Company

Our client is a China-based IoT and telecommunications solutions provider with a global footprint. The company designs, manufactures and operates connectivity solutions including cellular modules, IoT devices, and messaging platforms, working closely with telecom operators worldwide to enable SMS A2P, Voice and IoT connectivity.

As part of its expansion in LATAM, the company is creating its first commercial role in Brazil, focused on building and strengthening relationships with local telecom operators.

Role Overview

This is a commercial, operator-facing role, focused on wholesale telecom and carrier relationships. The position is not technical and not end-customer sales.

The successful candidate will act as the local commercial interface between Brazilian telecom operators and the company’s global teams, supporting market development, carrier negotiations and long-term partnerships. This is a newly created position, offering growth potential as the LATAM operation expands.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain commercial relationships with telecom operators in Brazil
  • Support and participate in operator-to-operator negotiations, including:
    • Wholesale Voice
    • A2P SMS
    • Interconnect agreements
  • Identify market opportunities, pricing trends and cost-optimization opportunities
  • Coordinate with internal teams and report directly to a China-based Director
  • Act as the local market representative, providing insights on competition, pricing and regulatory dynamics
  • Support the development of long-term carrier partnerships across Brazil (and potentially LATAM)

Required Experience & Profile

  • 2+ years of experience in the telecom wholesale / carrier environment
  • Background in one or more of the following areas:
    • Wholesale telecom
    • Carrier Relations
    • Interconnect
    • Voice or A2P SMS
  • Experience working directly with telecom operators (operator-to-operator), not only with end customers
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills
  • Fluent English for daily communication with international teams
  • Comfortable working in a new role with high autonomy

Nice to Have

  • Experience with A2P SMS platforms or messaging services
  • Exposure to international wholesale markets
  • Chinese (not mandatory, but a plus)

Why Join

  • Newly created role with high visibility and growth potential
  • Opportunity to work in a global, international environment
  • Direct exposure to telecom operators and international markets
  • Be part of the LATAM expansion of a global telecom and IoT player

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar atividades técnicas dos fisioterapeutas de seu setor (condutas fisioterapêuticas, evolução em prontuário, preenchimento de dados assistenciais obrigatórios e produtividade individual);

  • Atuar na prevenção, recuperação e manutenção da saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos pacientes utilizando os recursos fisioterapêuticos de forma a garantir um atendimento de excelência;

  • Participar e propor ações à equipe multidisciplinar nos âmbitos assistenciais a fim de programar o atendimento fisioterapêutico adequado à plena recuperação dos pacientes;
  • Checar prescrição médica no prontuário eletrônico do paciente a fim de realizar a adaptação da prescrição de acordo com a sua necessidade;

  • Fazer parte de grupos de discussão e trabalhos multiprofissionais da Instituição;
  • Redigir relatórios assistenciais ou intervir pessoalmente junto aos auditores internos para justificativa de atendimento às operadoras de saúde a fim de minimizar a ocorrência de glosas relativas ao Serviço de Fisioterapia;
  • Propor e participar de testes de novos materiais/equipamentos, bem como colaborar com parecer técnico para a aquisição de novas tecnologias;
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior.

  • Captação presencial de fotos e vídeos de imóveis (ambientes, detalhes, “tour”, amenities, vizinhança e pontos de interesse).

  • Experiência prática com captação em ambiente interno (luz, enquadramento, estabilidade, áudio).
  • Edição de vídeo em CapCut / Premiere / Final Cut / DaVinci (qualquer um, desde que entregue bem).
  • Noções de storytelling para Reels (ganho nos 2 primeiros segundos, cortes, texto na tela, CTA).

  • Experiência captando depoimentos com pessoas (condução, postura, naturalidade).
